what_this_is: The fresh-market benchmark for the first PetTripFinder market built on the post-Milwaukee generic path. Every figure is read from a committed artifact named in `artifacts`, so any of them can be re-derived and a later market can be compared to this one.

elapsed.basis: wall clock from the first command of the work order to the benchmark manifest, single operator, single session. Provider work ran in the background and is inside this figure, not beside it.

phases.note: reading the existing generic path before writing anything: discovery engine, census/partition contracts, corridor assignment, acquisition registry, providers, publication grade, launch participation, deployment manifest
geography authorship (18 discovery cells, 16 corridors, 105 postal codes, the boundary exclusion list) plus the pending market contract
36 Overpass requests then 72 Google Places requests, plus one cache-only merge pass
the new generic projection module and the three defects found by inspecting its output
the new whole-census routing module; zero provider decisions reopened
building the reserved direct_http lane, the brand reachability probe, and three full 141-property passes

zero_cost_recovery.what_it_asked: whether any persisted DECLINED document contains a policy block the walk that ran never read -- asked offline, before any repeated network acquisition

cost.basis: 72 Google Places API (New) Text Search requests at the Enterprise SKU list price of $0.035 per request (the field mask includes addressComponents, websiteUri and nationalPhoneNumber). Estimated from the request count this run made and the published unit price; no invoice has been observed. Overpass is free and unmetered. Firecrawl and Bright Data made ZERO calls: neither credential is present in this environment, so no paid acquisition lane could run at all.
cost.note: The $10 market cap was never approached and never needed a STOP. The binding constraint in this environment was not money, it was credentials.

new_generic_modules.why: Atlas could discover a market and could rebuild a census from committed authority, but had nothing between the two. Four prior markets turned a candidate list into a census by hand in four market-specific scripts totalling ~4,600 lines.
new_generic_modules.reusable: every future market's census, and the only place category, membership and identity reconciliation are decided

new_generic_modules.why: a census builder that reads the market contract from a PATH, because a market being built is not yet registered and registering it touches the signed deployment authorization
new_generic_modules.reusable: every future market, and the pre-registration workflow generally

new_generic_modules.why: no module answered 'route this whole census' -- each market re-derived brand, URL shape and lane in its own script
new_generic_modules.reusable: every market; the URL-shape vocabulary is what stops brand-index URLs being counted as routed

new_generic_modules.why: providers.DIRECT_HTTP was a reserved, declared-UNAVAILABLE slot with a written intent and no implementation
new_generic_modules.reusable: the cheapest rung of every future ladder; reaches DRURY, ESA, SONESTA, WYNDHAM and independents at zero cost

new_generic_modules.why: a route is added by a benchmark, never an opinion, so the new lane needed a measurement harness before it could ever become a route
new_generic_modules.reusable: the shape every future lane measurement takes

new_generic_modules.why: the current-state store was built by market-specific integration scripts; this derives it offline from persisted artifacts
new_generic_modules.reusable: every market, and every zero-cost re-derivation pass

new_generic_modules.why: the closure vocabulary lived in acquisition/closure_038.py, a module whose second line is MARKET = 'milwaukee-wi'
new_generic_modules.reusable: every market; a test pins it to Milwaukee's tuple so the extraction cannot have changed a word

new_generic_modules.why: active eligibility, the final partition and the closure ledger were three market-specific derivations
new_generic_modules.reusable: every market; one mapping from partition blocker to closure disposition, so the two artifacts cannot disagree
every market; writes only MACHINE_REVIEWED_PENDING_OPERATOR and carries the semantic-approval/1.0 hash material

new_generic_modules.why: no benchmark artifact existed at all
new_generic_modules.reusable: comparing market N+1 to this run

modified_shared_files.why: every existing blocker names work the MACHINE still owes. A reviewed, publication-grade candidate owes nothing but a human, and had to borrow a state that was false about it -- Milwaukee filed 133 identities as AWAITING_POLICY_OBSERVATION including the ones whose policy had been observed.

modified_shared_files.change: the written meaning of that state
modified_shared_files.why: the contract requires every state to have one, and a test enforces it

modified_shared_files.change: the next action that state demands
modified_shared_files.why: the builder refuses a blocker with no next action

new_config_files.why: 18 discovery cells, the bi-state bounding box and 70 municipalities. Resolved by CONVENTION -- zero code changes, no registry edit, no merge conflict with any other market branch.
a valid ptf-market/1.1 contract, deliberately outside the registry directory

custom_fixes.defect: the non-lodging veto was unreachable: it read category_candidates, which is OUR query vocabulary and reads {hotel, motel} on every candidate of a lodging run
custom_fixes.found_by: inspecting the projection's own output -- 565 candidates, 0 classified NOT_LODGING
custom_fixes.cost: 24 RV parks, campgrounds, bed-and-breakfasts, guest houses and vacation rentals would have entered the census

custom_fixes.defect: membership was tested before identity reconciliation, so an address-less row with coordinates was excluded as out-of-market instead of being absorbed into the addressed row it duplicated
custom_fixes.found_by: ABSORBED count of 0 against 40 known address-less candidates

custom_fixes.defect: an unqualified brand name is a VALID identity key, so deduplicating the census by key was about to reduce 25 distinct buildings at 25 distinct street addresses to 3
custom_fixes.found_by: reading the collision list -- 'Comfort Inn' at three addresses, 'Drury Inn & Suites' at four, 'Red Roof Inn' at four
custom_fixes.cost: real hotels deleted silently; this is the third market in which bare brand names have threatened an identity-key collapse

custom_fixes.defect: a served Handlebars template read as POLICY_NOT_FOUND. Wyndham's property page literally contains 'Pet Policy {{pets}}'
custom_fixes.found_by: probing one Wyndham document by hand after 26 identical POLICY_NOT_FOUND outcomes
custom_fixes.cost: 26 hotels would have closed as 'states nothing about pets', which is a claim about the WORLD derived from a fact about our lane

custom_fixes.defect: AWAITING_POLICY_OBSERVATION covers both 'the page served and said nothing' and 'nobody has fetched it', and the first closure run merged them -- 198 identities reported as POLICY_NOT_FOUND of which 146 had never been fetched
custom_fixes.found_by: reading the first closure ledger against the pilot's attempted count
custom_fixes.cost: the single most misleading number the benchmark could have produced

custom_fixes.defect: identity_check.name_on_page was filled from the document <title>, and the membrane's M10 gate rejected five captures whose identity the capture gate had already confirmed on street, postal code and telephone
custom_fixes.found_by: readiness POLICY_NOT_FOUND on rows whose publication grade was CONFIRMED
custom_fixes.cost: 5 of 17 publication-grade candidates would have been withheld for a reason that was ours

interventions.what: authored the market geography: 18 discovery cells, the bi-state bounding box, 16 corridors, 105 postal codes and the written exclusion list (Waterloo IL, Pevely, House Springs, Festus, St. Clair MO, New Melle, Wright City, Ste. Genevieve)
interventions.automatable: no -- a traveller market boundary is a judgement, and the work order requires it to be documented rather than derived

interventions.what: decided NOT to register the market, after finding that registering it forces a launch_participation.json row whose sha256 the live deployment manifest pins and the founder's signed authorization copies
interventions.automatable: partly -- the coupling should be a documented gate rather than something each market build has to rediscover

interventions.what: hand-picked 22 URLs, two per brand, to measure which brands the free lane can reach before running it over 141 properties
interventions.automatable: yes -- a bounded reachability probe belongs in the pilot harness

interventions.what: found and fixed six defects by reading intermediate output; none was caught by an existing gate
interventions.automatable: partly -- three of the six are now covered by new tests in this work order

interventions.what: NOT DONE. 17 candidates are packaged and every one is MACHINE_REVIEWED_PENDING_OPERATOR with empty decision fields.
